repa_capture_max_layers: DiT hook; loss After Layer. Default 1.
repa_capture_modules_auto: Auto-select DiT modules for REPA feature capture.
repa_dinov2_model: DINOv2 backbone id used as the REPA teacher encoder.
repa_enabled: Classic REPA: align DiT intermediate features to an external vision encoder. Usually slower and more VRAM-heavy.
repa_projection_dim: Projection dimension for REPA student heads.
repa_target_modules: Module. Empty + auto → Backend By Layer mid (hook).
repa_target_provider: provider; none target When fail-closed (REPA). dinov2/jina.
repa_token_pool_size: Token pool size before REPA loss (0 = use encoder default).
resume: From A save_state Save Interrupted State Continue Training, Fill File Path
safeguard_loss_spike_threshold: Current loss When, As spike step
safeguard_nan_check_interval: N Optimize step NaN / Inf loss
safeguard_safe_state_interval: Snapshot adapter + optimizer state to CPU every N steps, for rollback. Independent from NaN detection; larger values cost less.
sample_cache_seam_backend: Preview-sample cache seam backend (off / spectrum / smoothcache family).
sample_cache_seam_window_size: Window size for the preview-sample cache seam.
sample_difficulty_metadata_path: JSON File. Empty When Auto <train_data_dir>/sample_difficulty.json; Path Auto Path.
sample_difficulty_weighting_enabled: Dataset Weight, Or By Current batch detached loss Auto / Sample.
sample_fsg_probe: Feature-space guidance / FSG probe for sample path experiments.
sample_smoothcache_error_threshold: Error threshold that invalidates SmoothCache entries.
sample_smoothcache_probe: Error-guided SmoothCache probe for preview acceleration research.
sample_spectrum_stop_caching_step: Stop Spectrum caching after this sample step (0 = never).
sample_spectrum_window_size: Spectrum cache window size in sample steps.
sample_tgate_probe: T-GATE cross-attention reuse probe for preview paths.
save_every_n_epochs: Save a checkpoint every N epochs. Default 1 matches backend.
save_every_n_steps: N Save. 0 Only In Training When Save
save_last_n_epochs: Only N By epoch Save Model
save_last_n_epochs_state: Only Save After n epoch Training State
save_last_n_steps: Only N By step Save Model
save_model_as: On-disk save format for the trained model/LoRA.
save_n_epoch_ratio: By epoch Ratio Save, Training Save N Model
save_precision: LoRA/ Merge dense Precision. auto= Follow / Mixed Precision; INT8/FP8 dequant After Output Precision (Comfy INT8 LoRA)
save_state: Save Training State resume Params Continue From A State Training
sc_quality_dropout: Stochastic quality dropout rate for SC / curriculum paths.
sds_lora_refresh_phases: Number of QR refresh phases across SDS-LoRA training.
sdxl_block_swap_input_blocks: Recommended After. Swap U-Net input blocks
sdxl_block_swap_offload_after_backward: After backward, immediately offload SDXL swapped blocks to free VRAM sooner.
sdxl_block_swap_vram_threshold: VRAM threshold that triggers SDXL block swap (advanced).
sdxl_low_vram_auto_protection: Auto-enable SDXL low-VRAM protections when free VRAM is low.
sdxl_low_vram_auto_resolution_probe: Probe safe resolution under low-VRAM before full training.
sdxl_low_vram_component_cpu_residency: Keep selected SDXL components resident on CPU between uses.
sdxl_low_vram_resolution_mode: Resolution policy under low-VRAM (long_edge recommended; short_edge saves more VRAM).
sdxl_low_vram_swap_input_blocks: Also swap U-Net input blocks for extra VRAM headroom.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_offload_after_backwar: Offload SDXL low-VRAM swapped blocks right after backward.
sdxl_low_vram_two_phase_cache: Two-phase cache build for SDXL low-VRAM (encode then train).
sfad_enabled: By Tag Frequency caption tag dropout
sigma_depth_schedule_enabled: By Current Sample RF σ DiT Depth; block identity (grad). And Vortex Aircon.
sigma_depth_schedule_mode: hard_depth= By σ Max Depth; soft_prob= Depth After.
softrepa_enabled: SoftREPA: scheduled soft feature alignment (lighter than classic REPA).
softrepa_max_weight: Maximum SoftREPA loss weight in the schedule.
softrepa_min_weight: Minimum SoftREPA loss weight in the schedule.
softrepa_sigma_max: Upper raw-sigma bound where SoftREPA is active.
softrepa_sigma_min: Lower raw-sigma bound where SoftREPA is active.
step_phase_profile_enabled: Record step-phase profiles for diagnostics (small overhead).
stochastic_depth_decay: Decay schedule for stochastic depth survival probability.
stochastic_depth_enabled: Stochastic depth on DiT blocks (regularization; may change quality).
stochastic_depth_min_blocks_kept: Minimum number of blocks kept when stochastic depth drops layers.
stochastic_depth_survival_prob: Base survival probability for stochastic depth.
student_scheduler: Student few-step scheduler id for distillation runs.
swap_granularity: VRAM swap granularity / mode for component residency.
sync_missing_assets_from_main: Only worker. By From Model, Dataset, resume Etc. Path
t5_max_token_length: Max token length for T5 text encoder paths.
t5xxl_max_token_length: Max token length for T5-XXL text encoder paths.
target_image_path: ADDifT Target Image. And Original Image Resolution.
tc_lora_hidden_dim: Hidden dim inside the TC-LoRA hypernetwork.
text_encoder: Qwen Image Text Encoder Path, Empty Etc. After
text_encoder_cpu: Keep text encoder on CPU to save VRAM (slower TE path).
text_encoder_outputs_cache_disk_format: Text Encoder Output Cache File Format
text_encoder_outputs_cache_dtype: Text Encoder Output Disk Cache Save Precision
thunder_jit_cache_enabled: By Model, dtype, rank, shape, Execution And RNG Cache.
thunder_jit_executors: nvFuser + SDPA Is Recommended; torchcompile executor Only.
timestep_weighting_mode: Timestep weighting mode (may use a LUT for non-uniform schedules).
torch_compile: Legacy torch.compile toggle kept for config migration. Prefer the compile-settings section knobs.
torch_compile_allow_full_with_per_block: Advanced: full And per_block Strategy When.
torch_compile_fallback_enabled: On: compile failure falls back to eager with a warning log. Off: compile failure raises immediately (fail-fast) instead of silently falling back.
torch_compile_mode: torch.compile mode (default / reduce-overhead / max-autotune). Higher modes may use more VRAM.
train_quant_preset: : To weight_compression_preset. Recommended stable_backbone_int8; off=. And keep_w8.
train_t5xxl: Training T5-XXL Text Encoder (Not Recommended, VRAM Overhead Very Large)
training_quantization_enabled: Alias toggle for training-time quantization (pairs with quantization_enabled).
training_quantization_type: Training quantization type when the alias toggle is on.
tuneqdm_enabled: Experimental (ECCV 2024 TuneQDM): keep INT8 weights frozen and train only the dequant scales; stacks with LoRA or works alone. Requires the keep_w8 INT8 base (Keep INT8 Frozen Training), otherwise skipped. Trained scales are saved as a .tuneqdm_scales.safetensors sidecar next to the checkpoint. Synthetic validation passed; real-run quality not yet signed off.
tuneqdm_warmup_steps: Linear LR warm-up (0→1 multiplier) on the scale param group for the first N optimizer steps; 0 = no warm-up.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_high: High acceptance threshold for turbo/few-step distillation filtering.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_low: Low acceptance threshold for turbo/few-step distillation filtering.
turbo_lora_distill_cosine_weight: Cosine-alignment weight in turbo LoRA distillation loss.
turbo_lora_draft_hidden_dim: DiT Layer Dim (, Default 512 ≈ Target Model 1
turbocore_disable: Hard-disable TurboCore even if the top bar requests it.
turbocore_enabled: Master switch: routes the optimizer step through CUDA/Triton accelerated kernels; off = standard PyTorch path. When on, Optimizer Backend is hidden and the Lulynx Triton optimizer is forced off.
turbocore_mode: Requires the TurboCore master switch above.
turbocore_prefetch_depth: How many optimizer/update chunks TurboCore prefetches ahead.
turbocore_profile: TurboCore performance profile preset for kernel/workspace trade-offs.
turbocore_workspace_mb: TurboCore workspace budget in MiB (0 = auto).
twinflow_adversarial_enabled: : EMA fake + When L_adv + / rectify. Before; discriminator;.
twinflow_enabled: EMA-of-LoRA teacher + RCGM/real-velocity. Before VRAM;. And distillation (When distillation).
unet_path: SDXL UNet, checkpoint Or diffusers Model Path.
universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv: When On By Layer Linear, q/k/v slice adapter.
universal_dit_enabled: DiT/Transformer Static, Auto Linear target LoRA.
universal_dit_forward_mapping_json: Optional. Explicit mapping (JSON object) for cache-to-forward parameter name mismatches; leave empty to infer from probing.
universal_dit_output_selector_json: Optional. Required when the forward returns multiple tensors: pick the training target output, e.g. {"index":0} or {"key":"sample"}.
universal_dit_probe_mode: auto By Input Execution Static And Before; train_smoke Execution Min .
universal_dit_target_modules_json: Only explicit Strategy, ["blocks.0.attn.to_q", "blocks.0.mlp.fc1"]. Path In As nn.Linear.
universal_dit_target_policy: attention_mlp Only Attention /MLP; all_linear To Linear; explicit Path.
up_lr_weight: U-Net Decoder Layer Learning Rate Weight, 12
use_cache: Enable the product cache pipeline (latents / TE outputs as configured).
vae_slicing: VAE Encode / Decode When Slicing (Save VRAM).
vae_tiling: VAE Chunk Handle (Handle Image When Save VRAM).
val_data_dir: Validation Image Directory. Empty When Fallback As Training Directory
vortex_low_vram_prefetch_throttle: Low VRAM When Prefetch Depth, Prefetch VRAM. Default Enable.
vortex_low_vram_protection_enabled: When On Allow Vortex In Low VRAM
vram_auto_enhance_enabled: VRAM When Auto Enable Block Checkpointing
vram_auto_tier: By VRAM / Write Compression And knobs; T3 Force. KPI= OOM.
vram_auto_tier_force_extreme: Force the extreme low-VRAM tier even when free VRAM looks higher.
vram_smart_sensing_baseline_steps: Baseline steps used to estimate VRAM smart-sensing deltas.
vram_smart_sensing_delta_cache_enabled: Cache VRAM delta estimates across sensing windows.
vram_smart_sensing_enabled: Sense VRAM pressure online and adjust swap/offload aggressiveness.
vram_smart_sensing_slowdown_ratio: Slowdown ratio that triggers more aggressive VRAM actions.
vram_smart_sensing_window_steps: Sensing window length in optimizer steps.
wan22_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Wan2.2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
wan22_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Wan2.2 block offload.
wan22_target_frames: Training clip target frames; keep 1 for single-image training.
wan22_frame_stride: Source-video frame gap between sampled frames.
wan22_fps: Metadata frame rate stored in the cache fingerprint; does not change sampling.
weight_compression_enabled: Advanced: In Preset When Enable Compression. Preset.
weight_compression_verify: Before Current Runtime Is Compression Backend.
wv3_head_path: Waifu Scorer v3 Weight Path. Empty When Auto Path
zero_terminal_snr: Zero Terminal SNR (v-pred Model Training Recommended Enable)
zimage_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Z-Image blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
zimage_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Z-Image block offload.
compression_companion_auto_bootstrap: When path is invalid, run one product-fp8 residual fit before apply (default-off).
compression_companion_bootstrap_rank: Residual LoRA rank for Phase-0 bootstrap.
compression_companion_bootstrap_max_laye: 0 = no cap (all intersecting Linears); >0 keep largest residual layers.
compression_companion_missing_policy: fail = hard stop (default); downgrade_t1 = disable companion, keep compress, no recovery claim.
preference_scoring_enabled: After training, score generated images with PickScore / ImageReward / HPSv2. Heavy weights; default off. Requires quality evaluation enabled.
preference_models: Comma-separated: pickscore,imagereward,hpsv2. Empty = pickscore only. Missing weights are marked skipped, never silent 0.
weight_decay: AdamW-family weight decay (L2). Prodigy/DAdaptation manage their own via optimizer_args.
weight_compression_target: none disables; backbone compresses DiT/U-Net; text_encoder compresses text encoders; both enables both.
sdpa_backend_policy: Only applies when the attention backend resolves to SDPA. Cutlass (EffiAttn) maps to PyTorch EFFICIENT_ATTENTION path.
adaptive_step_logging_enabled: Automatically lowers progress/TensorBoard step log frequency when logging overhead is high.
adaptive_step_logging_threshold: Throttle when logging time exceeds this share of step wall time; 0.01 means 1%.
caption_tag_mutate_scope: all = mutate whole caption; after_separator = only mutate the suffix after the scope separator.
caption_tag_scope_separator: When scope=after_separator, split caption at this string; head is protected, tail is mutable. Default |||
tag_group_shuffle: Shuffle tags within groups split by separator; replaces global shuffle when on. Stacks with after_separator on the mutable region.
tag_group_separator: Boundary for in-group shuffle (default |||). May match the scope separator.
caption_protect_prefix_from_dropout: When on, uniform/targeted dropout never removes the keep_tokens prefix.
train_text_encoder: Also finetune the CLIP text encoder (runtime default semantics); off trains U-Net only.
num_class_images: Prior preservation: number of class images to generate (0 = skip; runtime default 100).
instance_prompt: Instance prompt for the subject (e.g. sks subject); written into instance captions.
class_prompt: Class prompt used by prior preservation (e.g. a subject).
use_lora: Train as LoRA instead of full finetune (lora_rank remaps to network_dim).
ip_image_encoder_path: CLIP vision encoder path or HF id.
ip_num_tokens: Number of IP-Adapter tokens injected into UNet (SDXL default 16).
lokr_no_materialize_forward: Experimental: apply Kronecker factors without materializing the full weight; may save VRAM but can be slower.
lokr_no_materialize_strategy: Choose the no-materialize forward implementation; auto follows the current benchmark heuristic.
lllite_mlp_dim: Adapter bottleneck dimension (analogous to LoRA rank).
acceleration_profile: Runs acceleration preflight and suggests a tier for the current model family.
activation_compression_dtype: fp16/bf16 are stable; fp8_e4m3 halves activation memory but is lossy.
activation_compression_enabled: Compress activations to reduce VRAM usage.
activation_compression_min_tensor_mb: Only compress activation tensors above this size; smaller ones are not worth it.
adalora_mask_interval: Update the rank mask every N steps.
adapter_init_export_mode: auto exports a LoRA loadable by the original base model on final save.
adapter_mask_pruning_warmup_steps: During warmup only importance is accumulated; the mask is not updated.
adapter_target_policy_min_score: Layers whose importance score falls below this are filtered out. 0 disables the threshold.
adapter_target_policy_top_k: Directly specify how many of the most important layers to keep. 0 uses the fraction ratio.
anima_block_checkpointing: Anima's primary gradient checkpointing: recomputes activations per DiT block during backward, trading recompute time for lower VRAM usage. Saves more memory than generic checkpointing.
anima_controlnet_cond_dim: Intermediate channel width of the condition image encoder.
anima_controlnet_cond_resblocks: Residual blocks in the condition trunk; 0 disables.
anima_controlnet_dropout: Dropout after the mid block during training.
anima_controlnet_multiplier: Overall multiplier applied to condition residuals.
anima_controlnet_target_layers: Which DiT Linear layers to attach to.
anima_controlnet_use_aspp: Helps global structures such as depth/segmentation; can be off for lineart.
anima_controlnet_weights: Leave empty to train from scratch; can load Anima weights in community-readable layouts.
anima_mixed_loss_mask_policy: Applies only when a batch contains both masked and unmasked samples.
anima_sigmoid_scale: Compression factor of the sigmoid distribution.
anima_vram_optimizer: Anima packed/varlen memory optimization intent. Only takes effect with the FlashAttention 2 backend; enabling it requests packed varlen attention and picks the most memory-frugal checkpointing automatically. If the resolved runtime backend is not FlashAttention 2 it degrades automatically and logs the reason.
anima_weighting_scheme: Loss weighting scheme. Empty = unweighted; uniform is a legacy alias accepted by the backend (equivalent to unweighted).
auto_prodigy_growth_rate: Upper bound multiplier for d growth.
auto_prodigy_safeguard_warmup: Protects the adaptive step size during warmup.
batch_size: The real short test currently only allows batch size 1.
bucket_custom_resos: One per line, e.g. 1024x1024. Leave empty to generate buckets automatically from the strategy above; once filled, this bucket table takes priority and the bucketing strategy no longer applies.
caption_dropout_rate: Probability of dropping all tags at once.
caption_replacements_regex: When enabled, replacement rules are matched as regular expressions.
caption_source_trigger_only_ratio: Defaults to 10; keep only trigger words.
caption_tag_dropout_rate: Probability of randomly dropping tags listed below (comma-separated).
caption_tag_dropout_targets: Tags eligible for dropout. One per line, comma-separated also supported.
caption_variants_enabled: Train across multiple caption variants via suffix/ratio/curriculum sequences.
cls_pos_weight: Positive-class weight for classification. Leave empty for no extra weighting.
conditioning_data_dir: Conditioning image dataset path; when empty the backend falls back to sibling *_control files discovered automatically.
cooldown_minutes: Minimum pause in minutes per cooldown.
cooldown_until_temp_c: Wait until GPU temperature drops below this before continuing.
data_transfer_profile_window: Emit one transfer summary per this many accumulated transfers.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_easy_end: Prefer easy samples until training reaches this progress ratio.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_normal_e: Gradually admit hard samples after this ratio. Must not be smaller than the easy-phase endpoint.
decompose_both: LoKr additionally decomposes the smaller-side matrix.
dry_run: Enabled by default: writes a metadata stub without starting real training.
ema_decay: EMA decay rate. Closer to 1 is smoother.
enable_inference_accel: Optionally accelerate preview sampling: Spectrum/SmoothCache skip part
eval_data_dir: Standalone validation directory. When filled, no validation split is carved out of the training set.
experimental_attention_profile_window: History window each token may attend to (tokens, not steps); 0 means full attention.
export_comfy_int8_groupsize: Must be a power of 4; default 256.
flow_logit_std: Standard deviation of logit-normal timestep sampling; must be > 0.
flow_uncertainty_weighting_enabled: Learns a sigma-dependent uncertainty u(σ) so the loss becomes loss
flow_uniform_base_pixels: Base pixel count for resolution offset. 1024x1024 = 1048576.
flow_uniform_shift: Shift RF timesteps dynamically by image pixel count.
flow_uniform_static_ratio: Overrides dynamic resolution shift when filled. Leave empty to disable the fixed ratio.
gemma3_prompt: Gemma3 system prompt. Aligned with the official template by default.
gpu_circuit_temp_c: Hard-OPEN at this temperature. 0 = no temperature-based trip.
gpu_circuit_temp_warn_c: Warning band below the hard threshold; 0 = warnings off.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_ecc: OPEN when an ECC uncorrected increment is detected.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_throttle: OPEN when critical throttling is detected.
gpu_power_limit_w: Set the GPU power limit (watts) before training.
gpu_target_temp_c: Temperature loop: automatically lowers effective duty cycle above the target temperature.
gradient_guard_agc_eps: Lower bound on parameter norms to avoid division by zero.
gradient_release_grad_clip_mode: exact=exact global-norm clipping but reduces memory optimization (+183MB at gas=1, +91MB at gas=4); per_param=per-parameter clipping that keeps memory optimization but approximates the global norm; report_only=report the norm without clipping.
huber_scale: Overall scaling of the Huber loss.
immiscible_assignment_mode: standard=global-optimal Hungarian; lulynx_greedy=compatible with the existing row-wise greedy pass.
initial_epoch: Start counting from the given epoch number.
ip_noise_gamma: Input perturbation noise strength, commonly used as regularization.
ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Perturbation strength varies randomly between 0 and ip_noise_gamma.
keep_tokens: Keep the first N tokens unchanged when shuffling (0 = no protection).
layer_precision_activation_geometry_path: Reads native safetensors containing aggregated E[x²] only.
layer_precision_default: Default format for regular quantization-candidate layers.
layer_precision_overrides_json: For exact overrides signed off via A/B testing only.
layer_precision_policy: Protects sensitive layers (input/output, time modulation, AdaLN/Norm); shared by export and keep-W8.
layer_precision_sensitivity_mode: weight uses bounded reconstruction error; activation_geometry uses aggregated E[x²].
learning_rate: Overall learning rate. Ignored once separate U-Net/text-encoder learning rates are set.
lora_plus_enabled: Different learning-rate multipliers for the A/B matrices (B side faster).
loss_scheduler_cooldown: After a valid descent appears, ignore this many steps of plateau detection to reduce oscillation.
loss_scheduler_late_gamma: Used by the loss-weighted annealed cosine only.
loss_scheduler_lock_weight_threshold: Used by the loss-weighted annealed cosine only.
loss_scheduler_max_hold_steps: Maximum consecutive steps the cosine phase may fail to advance.
loss_scheduler_min_advance_ratio: Used by the loss-weighted annealed cosine only.
lossless_cache_replacement_strict: Verifies shard byte integrity; rebuilds the cache automatically on fingerprint mismatch.
ltx23_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves duplicated LTX-2.x dual-stream blocks and initializes new layers as identity residuals (video+audio output projections zeroed, existing bias included). The final save contains the complete new backbone.
ltx23_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total Transformer blocks after expansion (22B-dev natively 48).
ltx23_depth_expansion_train_scope: Choose new layers only, new layers plus peripheral modules, or all parameters.
ltx23_frame_stride: Source-video frame gap between sampled frames.
ltx23_isolate_modalities: true = vision-only; disables a2v/v2a cross attention.
ltx23_target_frames: Target frames per training clip; keep 1 for single-image training.
ltx23_text_encoder_path: Gemma3 text encoder matching the base; standard layouts resolve automatically, override for custom ones.
ltx23_video_vae_path: Video VAE matching the base; standard layouts resolve automatically, override for custom ones.
lulynx_weight_noise_bound_norm: Rescale tensor norms back to pre-noise values after injection to suppress long-run norm drift.
lulynx_weight_noise_log_every: Write metrics every N optimizer steps; 0 = logging off.
lulynx_weight_noise_sigma: Noise strength. For relative mode this multiplies RMS.
lycoris_preset: Preset passed to the LyCORIS library.
max_token_length: Maximum token length. CLIP×3=225 is a common value; backend minimum is 75.
max_validation_steps: At most how many validation batches per validation run.
min_snr_gamma: Min-SNR gamma; 5 is recommended when enabled.
model_fused_qkv: Model-level physical QKV/KV packing; serves as fallback path when co-enabled with Triton QKV. Off by default.
module_dropout: LoKr-specific probability of dropping an entire module at random.
native_resume_save_precision: Native resume sidecar files default to FP32 to fully preserve master weights. FP16/BF16 shrinks files, but resuming then starts from rounded weights.
newbie_target_modules: Target module list, one per line.
noise_offset: Adds noise offset during training to improve very dark or very bright generations; 0.1 recommended when enabled.
noise_offset_random_strength: Noise-offset strength varies randomly between 0 and noise_offset.
opt_adopt_clip_lambda: Gradient clipping coefficient λ to prevent early-step gradient explosion.
opt_aurora_damping: Row-norm equalization strength; 0 = off, 1 = fully equalized.
opt_aurora_pp_iterations: Projection iterations for row-norm equalization (leverage correction).
opt_kahan8bit_block_size: Block size for blockwise quantization; one of 64/128/256/512/1024/2048/4096. Larger means less absmax overhead but more quantization noise.
opt_kahan8bit_min_8bit_size: Tensors with fewer elements (norm/bias) keep fp32 matrices to avoid quantization noise on small tensors.
opt_kron_precond_update_prob: Probability of updating preconditioner matrices (randomized to amortize cost). 0.03 recommended.
opt_mars_ams_bound: Enable the AMSBound variant (second moment uses the historical maximum).
opt_mars_cautious: Enable the cautious mask, keeping only update components aligned with the gradient sign.
opt_mars_gamma: Gradient-correction strength; 0.025 recommended. Controls the variance-reduction force.
opt_mars_optimize_1d: Off: 1D parameters (bias/norm) use built-in AdamW; on: MARS updates them too.
opt_riemannion_ns_steps: Newton-Schulz iterations; more is more accurate but slower.
opt_riemannion_orthogonalize: Newton-Schulz orthogonalization of updates stabilizes step sizes on fixed-rank manifolds.
opt_riemannion_solve_eps: Numerical damping of the manifold solver to avoid ill-conditioned inversions.
opt_rose_gradient_centralization: Centralizes gradients by removing their mean; usually improves generalization.
opt_rose_stochastic_rounding: Stochastic rounding for low-precision weight updates reduces rounding-bias accumulation.
opt_scion_init_scale: Initialization scale factor affecting the initial estimate of optimizer state. 1.0 recommended.
opt_sf_beta: Built-in momentum β; 0.9 recommended. Controls smoothness of parameter averaging.
opt_soap_precondition_frequency: How often the preconditioner updates (every N steps).
optimizer_state_paging_enabled: Parks large optimizer-state tensors on CPU between steps.
optimizer_state_paging_min_tensor_mb: Only page state tensors larger than this size.
p2_weighting_mode: p2=(k+SNR)^-gamma; lulynx_structure/detail are this repo's saturation-engineered weights; off = identity.
p2_weighting_strength: 0 = identity weighting; benefits require same-condition A/B validation.
perlin_noise_offset_enabled: Replaces uniform noise_offset with a Perlin field.
perlin_noise_offset_scale: Field frequency; higher means finer texture.
preview_groups: Add multiple preview groups, each with its own seed and LoRA.
quant_requantize_policy: avoid backs off by default to avoid double-quantization noise.
random_triggers: Comma-separated trigger-word list or a file path.
random_triggers_position: Where trigger words are injected into the caption.
resolution: Training image resolution, width x height. Non-square supported but both sides must be multiples of 64.
resolution_aware_batch_base_resolution: train_batch_size applies as-is at this resolution.
resolution_aware_batch_max_factor: Largest batch upscale factor for small images.
resolution_aware_batch_min_factor: Smallest batch downscale factor for large images.
rs_lora_enabled: Rank-stabilized scaling: alpha scales with rank, allowing larger ranks.
sample_at_first: Generate one preview before training starts to verify prompt effects.
sample_every: Backend master frequency key: generate previews every N steps.
sample_every_n_epochs: Generate a preview every N epochs.
sample_every_n_steps: Generate a preview every N steps.
sample_sampler: Sampler for preview images (canonical names; old names are runtime aliases).
sample_seed: Preview seed. 0 or empty means random each time.
samples_dir: Optional; produces the base sample-file report.
save_last_n_steps_state: Keep training state only within the most recent N steps.
shuffle_caption: Shuffle tokens during training; superseded when tag-group shuffle is enabled.
shuffle_caption_tags_only: With structured JSON captions, shuffle tags only and keep natural-language description order.
smart_noise_focus_spread: Standard deviation of the focus Gaussian (in logSNR units).
staged_resolution_ratio_1024: Used by both the 1024 and 2048 bases.
target_dims: Score dimensions participating in training, one per line.
teacher_path: Optional; explicitly points at a teacher model resource.
thin_svd_export_enabled: Compress LoRA via SVD to the target rank on save; off by default, RS-LoRA skips automatically.
thin_svd_export_rank: Must be smaller than the original network_dim; empty or 0 disables compression.
timestep_segments: Segment configuration for piecewise timestep sampling.
token_string: New token absent from the tokenizer.
train_batch_size: Batch size. Higher values use more VRAM.
train_norm: Also train learnable scale/bias of normalization layers (LayerNorm/RMSNorm etc.).
training_intent: Pick an intent to preview suggestions first; only clicking "Apply unset items" writes to the draft, explicitly modified fields are never overwritten.
training_vram_profile: Submits the target VRAM tier; whether it is verified is decided by the backend per model family, variant, and measured evidence. Choosing 6GB does not mean all models support 6GB.
triton_ops_enabled: Off by default. Attempts LTX Triton injection only when the QKV sub-switch is also on.
triton_ops_inject_qkv: Standard video attn1 only; Perturbed, cross, and audio paths are skipped. When co-enabled with physical packing Triton hits first and misses fall back to the physical path.
unbalanced_factorization: LoKr swaps the larger side while factoring dimensions, changing
universal_dit_allow_remote_download: Allows base_model_path to resolve remote repositories; prefer downloading and verifying via Resource Center or locally first.
universal_dit_objective_template: Never silently guesses when the class name is unreliable for unknown models; auto requires confirmation when evidence is insufficient.
val_ratio: Random validation split by ratio when split is unused.
validation_seed: Random seed for the validation split.
validation_split: Legacy compatibility: carve a validation portion out of the training set automatically.
vera_d_initial: Initial value of the learnable scaling vector d.
vera_enabled: Shared random matrices + learnable vectors; far fewer parameters than LoRA.
vera_prng_key: PRNG seed for the shared random matrices.
vortex_enabled: When enabled, enters the explicit Vortex run contract only.
wandb_run_name: Display name of a single wandb run.
weight_compression_exclude_patterns: Optional, comma-separated; matching components/parameters are not compressed.
weight_compression_include_patterns: Optional, comma-separated; only matching components/parameters are compressed.
